description: Form 1040 (2025), line 8: additional income from complete Schedule 1 line 10 for the bounded unemployment class. Published exactly once into line-9 v5. Explicit zero when closed-empty unemployment meets complete absences; never a silent omission.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero under complete authority.

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes Form 1040 line 8 from complete Schedule 1 line 10. This amount is added exactly once to total income on line 9.
